_comment: Template for tools/gates/vendored.json. Copy it there and fill it in when you first copy a shared file in from another repository. Regenerate hashes whenever you re-copy — and re-copy rather than editing locally.
revision: the commit these files were copied from
_marker_note: A string that appears in the upstream original and must NOT survive templating. Usually the upstream repo or org name. The gate uses it to prove a substitution was completed.

verbatim._note: path -> sha256. Byte-identical to upstream, deliberately, so drift is detectable.

templated._note: path -> rule. Differs from upstream by a known substitution; checked for completeness.

docs/REVIEW.md.rule: upstream slug replaced with this repo's
